title: Selected Topics in Computer Science; Economics and Computation
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in CMSC351; and permission of CMNS-Computer Science Department.

Economics and Computation explores the interaction between the disciplines of economics and computer science. In one direction, we will see how computational thinking gives a new perspective on areas of economic theory such as game theory, mechanism design, and social choice. In the other direction, we will discuss how economic approaches can address timely questions in computer science and artificial intelligence.
